# Agent instructions (generated by shipyard install)

Codex discovers the reusable skills for this project under
`.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`; `.claude/skills/` is retained for
Claude/Hermes compatibility. When a task prompt says "use the
<name> skill", READ that file and follow it before acting — the
SKILL.md is the source of truth for that workflow.

Available skills:
- polish-ticket — `.agents/skills/polish-ticket/SKILL.md`
- execute-ticket — `.agents/skills/execute-ticket/SKILL.md`
- coverage-audit — `.agents/skills/coverage-audit/SKILL.md`
- write-ticket — `.agents/skills/write-ticket/SKILL.md`
- bugfix — `.agents/skills/bugfix/SKILL.md`
- feature — `.agents/skills/feature/SKILL.md`
- shipyard — `.agents/skills/shipyard/SKILL.md`
